name: ZirhUzBPE
summary: BPE tokenizer for Uzbek: 72k vocab trained on a 1.3 GB corpus + encyclopedia + explanatory dictionary (every dictionary headword is a single token), Cyrillic/Latin auto-transliteration, byte fallback. ~2x fewer tokens than GPT-4o/Llama-3 on Uzbek.
author: Xojiakbar Jamoldinov
